paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
notes: Mass-independent stellar cooling bound from globular cluster R parameter (horizontal branch to red giant branch star ratio). The paper derives g_agamma < 0.66×10^-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL, valid for axion masses below ~10 keV (as stated in abstract and discussion). This is the strongest constraint on axion-photon coupling in a wide mass range at the time of publication. The bound is encoded as a horizontal line spanning 0 to 10 keV (10^4 eV) to represent the mass-independent validity range. Best-fit value: g_agamma = 0.45^{+0.12}_{-0.16} × 10^-10 GeV^-1 (68% CL). The analysis accounts for helium mass fraction Y as a key systematic, using Y = 0.254 from low-metallicity H II regions matching the globular cluster metallicity range. | selector: text (sole candidate)
